Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Marketing Intern (FMCG) position at Henkel. As a junior digital marketer with a strong analytical mindset and hands-on experience in market analysis, content creation, and brand visibility, I am excited about the opportunity to support your Brand Manager in a dynamic FMCG environment.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, analyze performance data using tools like Google Analytics and SEMrush, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize client websites. My project mirook.com involved implementing structured data and conducting technical audits to improve search visibility, demonstrating my ability to work with facts and figures.

I am fluent in English, have a B1 level in Dutch, and am available for a 6-month internship starting in June or July 2026. I am eager to bring my multitasking skills, customer-oriented approach, and passion for marketing to Henkel's international team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to your brand's success.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Marketing Intern (FMCG) position at Henkel. With a strong foundation in digital marketing, a keen eye for data, and a passion for fast-moving consumer goods, I am eager to contribute to your dynamic team and support your Brand Manager in driving brand success.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have developed robust analytical skills by tracking and evaluating website performance using tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs. I regularly analyze market data and competitor activity to inform SEO and content strategies, which aligns directly with the responsibilities outlined in your job description. My ability to interpret data and translate it into actionable insights will enable me to effectively support monthly market analysis and brand performance monitoring.

I am also experienced in collaborating across departments and with external partners. At Episto, I work closely with content creators, developers, and clients to ensure seamless project execution. My background includes building and maintaining WordPress sites, which has honed my project management and communication skills. I am comfortable liaising with various stakeholders to ensure alignment and timely delivery.

My entrepreneurial spirit is demonstrated through my project mirook.com, where I designed and built a website from scratch, implemented structured data, and conducted technical SEO audits to improve visibility. This project showcases my ability to take initiative, work independently, and deliver measurable results—qualities that align with Henkel's culture of innovation and game-changing mindset.

I am fluent in English, have a B1 level in Dutch, and am available for a 6-month internship starting in June or July 2026. I am eager to bring my multitasking abilities, customer-oriented approach, and enthusiasm for FMCG to Henkel. I am particularly drawn to the opportunity to work in the professional haircare industry and to be part of a diverse intern community.

Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the chance to discuss how my skills and experiences can contribute to Henkel's success.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok

Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · SEO · GEO · Content · Web
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a strong analytical mindset and hands-on experience in market analysis, brand performance tracking, and content creation. At Episto, I run on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site build and maintenance for client sites, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. On my own project (mirook.com), I applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Comfortable with data analysis, competitor monitoring, and marketing mix support; quick to pick up new tools and platforms. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

## Core Skills
- Analytics & Reporting: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads
- SEO & GEO: on-page SEO, keyword research, technical SEO audits, structured data / JSON-LD schema, entity optimization, GEO & AEO (AI search visibility)
- Content & CMS: SEO blog & content writing, editorial content publishing, website content management, WordPress site building
- Web & Build: WordPress, Elementor, Astra theme, responsive web design, Canva, AI-assisted content tools
- Social: social media content & integration
- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)

## Experience

### Junior Digital Marketer — Episto (Remote), 2026–present
- Own on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, improving organic visibility and search rankings
- Write keyword-targeted blog content for client websites to grow organic traffic
- Build and maintain client websites in WordPress using Elementor and the Astra theme, including content uploads and page updates
- Track site performance with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Ads to guide SEO and content decisions

### Warehouse & Logistics — Katoen Natie (Antwerp), 2025–2026
- Maintained accuracy and efficiency in a high-volume, fast-paced logistics environment

### Front-End Developer — ViviDoctor (Belgium), 2018–2019
- Developed and optimized front-end features for a healthcare web application (AngularJS, JavaScript)

## Projects

### mirook.com — Website Design, SEO & GEO (2025–present)
- Designed and built a multi-page WordPress site (Elementor, Astra) for a Belgian youth chess champion: full site structure, on-page SEO, and social media integration (Instagram/Facebook)
- Implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema, including SportsEvent and FAQPage), entity/knowledge-graph markup, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines (GEO/AEO)
- Ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits, measurably raising the site's overall search-health score

## Education
- Karel de Grote Hogeschool, Antwerp — Coursework in Applied Computer Science (2022–2025)
- Celal Bayar University, Türkiye — Coursework in Computer Science (2012–2016)
